```yaml
name: OpenTherm V4.2 Specification Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run ADR documentation generation
      run: ./scripts/generate_adr_docs.sh

    - name: Commit and push ADR documentation
      run: |
        git add docs/adr/
        git commit -m "Add ADR-044 (Webhook) and ADR-045 (PS=1 parsing)"
        git push origin main
```
